title: The Only Square That Holds
setup: Black is a pawn up with the king leading it, and you have exactly one move that saves the game.
hint: The kings stand three squares apart on one file. Which move leaves a single empty square between them, with Black to play?
explanation:
## The Idea

Black's king leads its pawn, and chasing them loses. The only defense is the opposition.

{{Kd2}} leaves one empty square between the kings, with Black to move. The pawn cannot advance, because its own king stands in front of it, so Black has to step the king aside — and your king steps with it, taking the opposition again.

Go to c2 or e2 instead and Black takes the opposition, and the pawn walks home behind its king.
